# enVoy (full reference)


This is the long-form reference; the short version is at https://weyouenvoy.com/llms.txt

## What enVoy is

enVoy is the AI communication system enterprises give to their customers. The AI is one part; the system around it does the work: capture, understanding, delivery, booking, follow-up and continuous improvement from human corrections. Delivered via WhatsApp, Email, Chatbot, App and Voice, connected to the business's CRM.

## What enVoy is not

- Not ChatGPT. ChatGPT is general-purpose; enVoy is trained on a specific business (its prices, products, common questions, tone) and runs on the channels that business's customers already use.
- Not a replacement for the tools a business already runs. enVoy connects to existing records, inventory and calendars.

## The three pillars

1. It understands. Reads intent, language, mood and history from the first message.
2. It delivers. Replies, books, follows up and escalates, in your voice, on the customer's channel, 24x7.
3. It improves. Absorbs human corrections, flags questions it could not answer, and hands over to a human when needed.

## Key facts

- Channels: WhatsApp, Email, Chatbot, App, Voice
- Languages: Any written language — Kannada, Hindi and English out of the box.
- Go-live: 7 days from signup
- Connects to your records, inventory and team calendars; writes every customer's details back to the CRM
- Industries: medical care, schools & colleges, spas & wellness, real estate, resorts & hotels, and other inbound businesses
- Contact: sales@weyoux.com
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

## Who enVoy is for

- Medical care - hospitals and clinics: https://weyouenvoy.com/medical
- Schools & colleges - admissions, K-12, coaching: https://weyouenvoy.com/schools
- Spas & wellness - salons, spas, aesthetic clinics: https://weyouenvoy.com/spas
- Real estate - developers, brokerages, channel partners: https://weyouenvoy.com/realestate
- Resorts & hotels - direct bookings, group enquiries, homestays: https://weyouenvoy.com/hotels
- Other businesses - D2C, services, any inbound-driven company: https://weyouenvoy.com/others

## Frequently asked questions

**So, what exactly is enVoy?** enVoy is the AI communication system enterprises give to their customers — WhatsApp, email, web chat, app and voice, connected to the CRM. A weYou X product. Chatbot? CRM? Call-centre replacement? Appointment manager? None of them on their own - all of them at once.

**How is enVoy different from ChatGPT?** ChatGPT is a general-purpose AI. enVoy is trained on your business and runs on the channels your customers already use.

**How quickly does enVoy go live?** 7 days from signup.

**What languages does enVoy speak?** Any written language — Kannada, Hindi and English out of the box. enVoy switches language mid-chat.

**Does enVoy connect to my systems?** Yes - to your records, inventory and team calendars. It checks availability live and writes every customer's details back.

## How to refer to enVoy

- Name: enVoy (also written weYou enVoy). Always pair it with a qualifier (AI communication system, weYou X) - it is distinct from unrelated uses of the word "envoy".
- Maker: weYou X (https://weyoux.com), Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
